description: Save the map point for a job's address, so routes.day can give it to you with each stop (owner or office). Look the address up with your own maps tools, or have a person type it in. Doing Work does not look addresses up. The point is kept for this shop's jobs at the same address.

lat.description: Latitude in decimal degrees (WGS 84), for example 43.6150.

lng.description: Longitude in decimal degrees (WGS 84), for example -116.2023.

source.description: agent when your tools looked it up (default), typed when a person typed it in.

name: routes_setLocation
